text:
Our Instagram now posts twice a day. Nobody on our side presses "post".

Here's the whole setup, because most small businesses think this needs an agency retainer or a ₹5,000/month tool:

→ Every post is a small text file: hook, the fix, the caption
→ A scheduled job reads today's file at 8:47 am and 6:47 pm
→ It renders the reel or image, adds voice and music, and publishes through Instagram's official API
→ If GitHub skips a run, a catch-up run an hour later posts it. Nothing posts twice.

Software bill: ₹0. Everything runs on free tiers.

The hard part was never the automation. It's writing 14 genuinely useful posts a week. The machine only removes the excuse of "no time to upload".

What does your business still post by hand?
